raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":716,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM energy.employee e JOIN energy.energy_company ec ON e.company_id = ec.company_id JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON ec.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.level = 1 AND ad.name = '吉林省' AND e.education = '硕士'"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"统计硕士学历员工数量","tables":["MYSQL:energy.employee"],"columns":["education","employee_id"]},{"requirement":"限定吉林省电力企业","tables":["MYSQL:energy.energy_company","MYSQL:common.administrative_division"],"columns":["area_id","id","level","name"]}],"assumptions":["员工表education字段直接存储学历名称，'硕士'为有效取值","administrative_division表包含level和name字段，level=1表示省级行政区"]}
